about_the_game:
About the Game

After a catastrophic hyperspace jump gone wrong, you crash-land in the middle of a mysterious asteroid field. But this isn’t just any asteroid field — it was once home to the Spacenoid Arcology Group (SAG), an ambitious project designed to create self-sustaining cities in the depths of space.

SAG was humanity's attempt at building "living system" arcologies — self-sufficient habitats meant to support life indefinitely, cut off from the outside world. But something went wrong. The arcologies now lie abandoned, and the truth behind their failure is buried beneath layers of puzzles, hidden pathways, and cryptic messages.

It’s up to you to explore the ruins, piece together the story, and uncover the fate of the Spacenoids.

Key Features

3D Platforming – Master tight controls and fluid movement as you navigate complex environments.

Collectibles to Find – Hunt down hidden collectibles and lore pieces to uncover the fate of the Spacenoid Arcology Group through environmental storytelling and cryptic clues.


Low-Poly Aesthetic – A clean, minimalist art style that highlights the beauty and isolation of deep space.

Uncover the Truth

Explore derelict stations, unlock hidden paths, and discover the truth behind the Spacenoids' downfall. The fate of humanity’s most ambitious project lies in your hands.

short_description: Spacenoids is a low-poly 3D Platforming Adventure. Unravel the mystery of the Spacenoids Arcology Group. This idea spawned from my partner challenging me to make a 3D Platformer from one of my school projects.
